description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL — a job imperatively enqueueing other jobs is control-flow smuggled into a dataflow engine. The northstar admits exactly two reasons work runs: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Every push site leaks scheduling policy into producers (duplicate fires, late-enqueue re-runs, self-scheduling walkers). The .18.19 concluded-coalesce is a SCREEN on the push, not a cure — its removal criterion is zero emissions.

INVENTORY (verified 2026-07-02 by the .18.19 removable-code audit; production emissions): jobs/body.rs (~72 refs — DeriveTypeDef, ReifyGuardDispatch pushes from lowering), jobs/semantic.rs (~66), jobs/root.rs (seed_root pushes; NOTE root.rs:75-76 LowerFunction+PlanEntryDispatch are PROVABLY ALWAYS-COALESCED post-.18.19 — proof: the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts whose producers must have concluded; first-run demand lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; delete these two as this arc's first family, own commit), jobs/dispatch.rs, jobs/keying.rs, jobs/contract.rs, jobs/types.rs, jobs/source.rs, source_publish.rs, quoted_expander.rs, world.rs. KEEP-classified by the same audit: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); all other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs — the conversion targets. Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already.

THE MIGRATION SHAPE (proven in-tree): consumers express missing prerequisites as FACT WAITS; the driver's fact->producer map (demand_product_fact_producer, compiler.rs / jobs/backend.rs) demands the single producer for a missing FactKey. Extend that map to the semantic facts (TypeDefined, GuardDispatchReified, FunctionDefined, LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, ActivationAnalyzed, ...); convert each emission site to a wait; SeedRoot shrinks to publishing root facts only. Work consumers-backward per family (DeriveTypeDef pushes first — most numerous, most mechanical), one commit per family, trace-proven per the minimal-job-trace gate (job counts drop or hold; products byte-identical).

WATCH ITEMS to resolve during migration: (1) semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up historically forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocker (proven never load-bearing, but resolve the producer relationship properly); (2) the coalesced-telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:257 vs :228-232) — split the observability when this lands.

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted (nothing left to screen); scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only; docs updated (fact-engine.md drops 'legacy jobs may enqueue follow-ups'). Blocked by fz-go4.18.22 (LANDED — this is now unblocked).

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
